summary: Workflow fails core requirement: doesn't implement mandated test harness (run through `act push`, capture to `act-result.txt`, assert exact values). Script has unquoted sed replacement variable (line ~131) risking injection if version contains `/`, `&`, or `\`. Workflow references test fixtures (`tests/bump_version.bats`, `tests/fixtures/`) that don't exist in deliverable. Script lacks commits-file format validation and special-char escaping in echo statements. Workflow only runs bats directly; requirements demand all test execution through act pipeline.
